notes: Custom words now tell you when a word can never apply. A line under the word on the Vocabulary page says why, for example that the period in Node.js keeps it from applying, or that a replacement turns it off. The line updates as you type and when you add or remove a replacement, and it never stops a word from being saved. If a new English model downloading in the background became ready while you were switching to the Multilingual model, and you then pressed Stop the download or the switch failed, the old English model could stay in use until the next launch. Koegaki now tries the new one again in the background, so it can take over without a restart.
